item.title: Young Artist Space dance studio aims to teach identity, artistry
item.description: Lifelong dancer Alli Neeley opened Young Artist Space in Greystone to foster joyful, faith-centered training for girls ages 2–19, blending technique, confidence and creativity in a positive studio environment.

item.title: Oak Mountain High recognized as official semiquincentennial school
item.description: Oak Mountain High earned semiquincentennial status for honoring U.S. history, while author Dale Alexander visited Shelby County schools to teach financial literacy and gift seniors his book through a legislative grant.

item.title: Get to know: Occupational therapist Amber Joiner
item.description: Oak Mountain alum and Auburn grad, this 37-year-old occupational therapist and mom of two shares her passion for family, helping older adults live independently, photography and raising kind, empathetic sons.

item.title: Hoover Small Business Alliance breakfast rescheduled to March 11
item.description: Hoover Mayor Nick Derzis will be doing a question-and-answer session.

item.title: Nature journaling program invites participants to explore Oak Mountain’s winter landscape
item.description: Oak Mountain State Park will host “Field Notes & Forest Finds: Nature Journaling” on Feb. 21 at 11 a.m. at the Oak Mountain Interpretive Center, encouraging participants to slow down and document the natural world through writing and sketching.

item.title: A taste of togetherness at Village Tavern Birmingham
item.description: Village Tavern at The Summit blends Southern hospitality with fresh, classic cuisine, celebrating 40 years of food and fellowship while offering Birmingham diners a warm, welcoming experience.

item.title: Discover Shelby and Shelby County Chamber to offer certified customer service training
item.description: A free two-day Certified Flawless Delivery© workshop will be held Feb. 23-24 in Chelsea for Shelby County tourism, recreation and customer service professionals.

item.title: Chelsea Kiwanis invites community to annual pancake breakfast fundraiser
item.description: The Chelsea Kiwanis Club will host its annual Pancake Breakfast on Feb. 22 at the Chelsea Community Center, with proceeds benefiting local children and youth programs.

item.title: Basketball postseason play underway
item.description: High school basketball area tournaments and sub-regionals are in the books.
